steelman: The plan is a principled refactor that splits a monolithic provisioner into a layered stack (detect → provider/desktop-config → merge-settings → wizard → orchestrator → provisioner) where every layer is pure except the edges. The strongest case for the plan is the explicit refusal to write blindly: detection reads configLibrary/_meta.json to find the active <appliedId>.json, then mergeGatewayIntoDesktopConfig only ever sets the three gateway keys (inferenceProvider, inferenceGatewayBaseUrl, inferenceGatewayApiKey, plus inferenceGatewayAuthScheme) and Object.assigns the rest of the user's file. This means the user's existing inferenceModels, coworkEgressAllowedHosts, toolSearchEnabled, telemetry toggles, and anthropicFamilyTier-free model entries are preserved verbatim — exactly what the user asked for. The second-strongest case is that installClaudeCli() becoming opt-in is a single, surgical change inside cli/provision.mjs: the function already short-circuits on preferNativeClaudeOnPath(), so flipping the default from 'always call' to 'only call when wizard/flag opts in' is a one-line guard plus the orchestrator passing the right flag. The third-strongest case is backward compatibility: cli/install.mjs shim, install.sh, and interactive-setup.mjs (reduced to a compat re-export) all stay green. The hard gate on merge-settings.test.mjs keeps the canonical settings-merge contract locked at commit 3, so a refactor regression can't escape into later commits.

tradeoff_tensions.title: interactive-setup.mjs shim vs existing readline-mock tests

tradeoff_tensions.title: Single-target 'Desktop only' path needs explicit confirmation in the orchestrator
tradeoff_tensions.resolution: State explicitly in §1 orchestrator: when 'claude-code' is not in targets, skip writeClaudeSettings, syncAgentFiles, syncSkillFiles, syncCommandFiles, syncHookFiles, syncRulesFiles, setupMcpServer, installClaudeCli. Keep OpenKan and CLAUDE.md mirror runs because they are Bizar-side state, not Claude-side state.

tradeoff_tensions.title: Worktree discipline is assumed but not stated in the plan
tradeoff_tensions.resolution: Add a one-line note to §9: 'Each commit is dispatched via Agent({ isolation: 'worktree' }) from the office-manager; sequencer merges with bizar worktree-merge --all per AGENTS.md.'

tradeoff_tensions.resolution: Add a §7 desktop-config.test.mjs case: simulate a write that succeeds but produces invalid JSON (truncate the buffer in a fs mock), assert the helper restores from the .bak-<unix-ms> sibling.
